title: 3 Days & 2 Nights Yoga Retreat in Uluwatu Bali
metaTitle: 3 Days Yoga Retreat in Uluwatu Bali
summary: A 3 days & 2 nights yoga retreat in Uluwatu with daily pranayama & meditation, Hatha Vinyasa yoga, healing sessions and 2 complimentary Balinese massages.
intro: Yoga instructors at Bali Yoga School teach authentic and personalised yoga lessons along with detox and de-stress therapies irrespective of your age and experience. The yoga retreat enables you to integrate the benefits of yoga with meditation, asanas, pranayama, yogic kriyas, deep relaxation, etc into your daily life.

Our teachers possess the ancient knowledge and modern yoga teaching methods to offer classes for beginner, intermediate and advanced levels for yoga. We offer yoga/ detoxification & meditation sessions.
durationStatements: 3 DAYS & 2 NIGHTS YOGA RETREAT IN ULUWATU BALI

schedule.heading: Retreat Dates & Fees

inclusions: Nutritious and delicious vegan / vegetarian meals
Complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi in the campus
All necessary items for the classes are available in the yogashala
Course materials (BYS bag / BYS t-shirt / notebook / pen / mala)

dining.text: We serve plant-based meals, prepared with the highest standards of hygiene, cleanliness, and love to support your yoga journey. Lunch & Dinner are not served on Sundays.

arrival: Check In – On the Day 1st after 12:00 pm
Check Out – On the last day before 12:00 pm

The best and most convenient way to travel to Bali Yoga School is to take a flight to Denpasar Bali airport. Denpasar Bali airport is merely 38 km away from our school. As soon as you book your flight, forward us your flight details and we will send our driver to meet you from Denpasar Bali airport and drive to the school.
prerequisites: Classes offered for beginner, intermediate and advanced levels.

policies.title: Class timings
items: The Management team holds the right to change the timings of the classes if it is needed.

policies.title: Booking Process
items: In order to book for retreat kindly deposit the Advance booking amount of 150 USD. Balance should be paid on arrival either by card, cash or Online transfer. An official confirmation letter concerning your program will be sent to you shortly after successful advance booking fee.

policies.title: Refund Policy
items: Advance Booking deposit is non refundable, we accept date rescheduling. If you cancel the course after joining, we accept the cancellation but the course fees will not be refunded with the cancellation.

issues: Intro copy describes the Ubud centre ('Our yoga retreat center is located in heart of Bali (Ubud)…') on an Uluwatu page — Ubud sentences removed from intro; needs Uluwatu-specific copy.
Fees identical for the 3-day and 4-day Uluwatu retreats ($500→$400 / $340→$270 / $260→$200) — one of them is likely wrong.
Private room is labelled 'Campus-I' on an Uluwatu page (Campus-I is used for Ubud elsewhere) — verify campus naming.
Intro/meta contain unverified marketing claims (e.g. 'best', 'one of the island’s most respected/trusted/leading yoga centers', 'We guarantee…') — not used.
Retreat dates statement refers to 2025 — outdated relative to the 2026 capture.
Accommodation text says 'renew yourself each day during your yoga teacher training' — copied from a YTT page.
Meal timings list lunch 13:00 – 14:00 but the daily schedule shows lunch at 12:30 pm.
Meal note says 'Lunch & Dinner are not served on Sundays' while the retreat runs year-round with lunch and dinner every schedule day — verify.
Airport paragraph ('Denpasar Bali airport is merely 38 km away from our school') is identical to the Ubud pages — distance unverified for Uluwatu.
Inclusion '2 complimentary Balinese massages' matches the 2 massage slots in the schedule (Days 1–2).
Price for 'Course with Meals (No Room)' is labelled '20% off' but 340 → 270 is not exactly 20% off (20% off would be 272; actual 20.6% off).
Price for 'Course with No Rooms, No Meals' is labelled '20% off' but 260 → 200 is not exactly 20% off (20% off would be 208; actual 23.1% off).
Teacher names (Yogini Chiara, Yogini Shanti, Yogi Pandu) are listed twice in the teachers block (duplicate carousel).
Founder section (Yogi Himanshu) contains unverifiable superlatives ('the most honest, hard-working, authentic person we can ever meet') — not extracted.
Page ends with a 'Yoga Retreats in Rishikesh, India – Learn More' cross-sell block (skipped; link target not captured).
